name: YAML Formatter
summary: Pretty-print or minify YAML with indent and optional key sorting — locally.
description: Paste YAML to reformat with consistent indentation (2 or 4 spaces). Optionally sort object keys, or minify into compact flow style. Invalid YAML shows a clear error. Runs entirely in your browser via js-yaml.

faqs.question: Does it validate YAML?
faqs.answer: Yes — invalid YAML cannot be formatted and shows a parse error. It does not enforce a schema.

faqs.question: What does minify do?
faqs.answer: It rewrites the document in compact flow style so nested structures use braces and brackets where possible.

faqs.question: Is my YAML uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing and formatting run entirely in your browser.
